comment: Not a buildable circuit: an 8-page design analysis (Ryan Williams) of the SSM2040 filter's discrete OTA cell (p1) and exponential current sink (p5), drawn as simulation fragments with an ideal op amp, generic NPN/PNP transistors and R7 left without a value, so no parts list is given.
